items.claim: Dustin Stoltzfus has poor defensive habits when entering the pocket with his hands down.
items.quote: He does not have very good defense because he'll often enter the pocket with his hands down

items.claim: Dustin Stoltzfus is a good grappler with decent takedowns and really good slams.
items.quote: he's a good grappler. Decent takedowns. He's got really good slams

items.claim: Dustin Stoltzfus attacks submissions very well and has good sweeps.
items.quote: he does attack submissions very well. He does have good sweeps.

items.claim: Mansour Abdul-Malik is a decent striker with a long jab and patience on the feet.
items.quote: He's just a decent striker, as well. He also has his problems defensively... but he does have a long jab. He is patient on the feet

items.claim: Mansour Abdul-Malik has knockout power capable of finishing Dustin Stoltzfus.
items.quote: he's definitely got the power to knock out a guy like Dustin Stoltzfus.

items.claim: Mansour Abdul-Malik has defensive problems and is very much open to counters.
items.quote: He also has his problems defensively... Mansour is very much open to counters, as well. It's not like he has great striking defense
